item: Print-truth loop: `kerf calibrate` builds a small A2L coupon (M2/M2.5/M3 clearance + tap + heat-set holes, 608 and 623 bearing pockets, 0.2/0.3/0.4 mm slip-fit pins, a servo-tab window). Spencer reports what fit (`kerf feedback <material> hole_M3=tight ...`); offsets are stored per printer+material in catalog/printers/ with the date and applied by iface, so every later design fits his real printer, not a textbook one. Tests use synthetic feedback
